> All task importance, time share, critical, needed-at-entry and target-level values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Credential gates and sign-off are shown only as drafts until an E-labelled source is attached.

- **Role:** Hydrologist (`seed:R17-hydrologist`, P2); authority position (editorial): regulated-party
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Plan water supply and allocation under hydrologic uncertainty — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Characterize groundwater systems and protect drinking water sources — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Build, calibrate and validate predictive and simulation models of environmental systems — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Assess stream channel form and function in the field — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
